messages:
Samir Patel: Heads-up — multiple hosted inference customers reporting 5xx from the API starting ~2026-04-12 11:12UTC. Symptoms: 502/503 at gateway with control-plane error id in body. Customers: tenant-acme, tenant-bravo. Customer-impacting and an ongoing escalation.
Samir Patel: Quick summary: control-plane deps failing (auth/session timeouts, routing-policy 500s, config DB timeouts). Initial spike aligns with a configdb latency bump.
support-bot: Incident INC-2026-1184 created for this thread
Alex Chen: oncall here. Can someone paste a sample x-request-id from a 11:12-11:16 failure? Need traces to correlate with control-plane logs.
Julian Park: reproducer (from my laptop):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Tenant: tenant-acme" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
# response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
# body: {"error":"controlplane_dep_error","detail":"auth/session timeout","x-request-id":"rq_20260412_11:13:02_7f9"}
```
Julian Park: x-request-id above = rq_20260412_11:13:02_7f9
Kate Morris: investigating auth/session side. I'm already seeing a heap of session-store timeouts 11:10-11:15 UTC. Sample from session-proxy logs:
```
[E] 2026-04-12T11:13:01Z tenant=tenant-acme session_get timeout=650ms err=redis-read-timeout
[E] 2026-04-12T11:13:03Z tenant=tenant-bravo session_get timeout=702ms err=redis-read-timeout
```
Kate Morris: Looks like config DB read latency increased and is propagating: session-service does a configdb lookup on cold keys which is timing out and then auth returns 500 -> gateway surfaces 502.
Maria Gomez: routing-policy team here. We're observing elevated cache miss rate ~28% and direct DB queries spiking. routing-policy is experiencing connect timeouts to configdb around same window.
Maria Gomez: routing-policy logs:
```
WARN 2026-04-12T11:12:59Z tenant=tenant-acme route_eval db_query time=540ms err=query-timeout
ERROR 2026-04-12T11:13:04Z route_eval panic: upstream configdb timeout
```
Alex Chen: Deploy bot check?
deploy-bot: No production deploys in last 24h. Rolling restarts: none in window.
Alex Chen: So not a bad deploy. Likely a configdb or network blip. Kate, Maria — can you confirm if the configdb is a single region read replica causing the fanout?
Kate Morris: Confirmed — read traffic hits primary in us-west-2, we saw increased p99 read latencies 11:08-11:16. DB metrics: p95=220ms, p99=620ms. There are some KV-lock spikes visible (long-running transactions holding locks).
Julian Park: Customer billing note: tenant-acme reported invoice job failures starting 11:13 — possibly because billing backend calls hosted API endpoints for usage calc and got 502s. Finance pinged support.
Samir Patel: Mitigations proposed: 1) temporarily enable routing-policy fallback to static/default rules for affected tenants 2) increase auth/session read timeout threshold to avoid cascading 5xx (return 429-ish?) 3) scale configdb read replicas / kill long-running queries 4) notify customers and disable heavy batch billing jobs until stabilized.
Maria Gomez: I can toggle fallback for tenant-acme and tenant-bravo now. Command to flip:
```
POST /internal/route-fallback
{ "tenant":"tenant-acme", "fallback_mode": "static" }
```
Kate Morris: I'll add a short-circuit in session-proxy to return a soft-failure (401) for expired sessions instead of hitting configdb for cold keys. Pushing change to canary in 5m.
Alex Chen: SRE action: throttle configdb read-heavy jobs and kill oldest transactions; I'll open a DB-maintenance runbook now and scale read replicas by +1.
support-bot: Noted action items: tag: SRE, Auth, Routing, Finance. Escalation: high priority.
Julian Park: Quick test after toggling fallback (I flipped tenant-acme):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Tenant: tenant-acme" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
# response: HTTP/1.1 200 OK (routing fallback active)
```
Samir Patel: Good. Please confirm per-tenant rollouts and post when each mitigation is done. Also capture root cause RFO: suspected KV lock surge on configdb causing cascading auth/session timeouts -> routing-policy 500s -> gateway 502s.
Kate Morris: Canary change applied at 11:21 UTC. Observed reduction in auth errors from 11:22.
Maria Gomez: Routing fallback applied for tenant-acme and tenant-bravo at 11:19 UTC. Error rates for those tenants dropped to baseline by 11:23.
Alex Chen: DB read replica scaled at 11:25 UTC; killed 4 long-running transactions. p99 back to ~80ms.
Samir Patel: Customer updates sent, finance notified about billing job pause for affected tenants. Can we keep monitoring for 2 hours and then discuss permanent mitigations (caching policy, stronger circuit breakers)?
Alex Chen: Agreed — I'll keep alerts muted for noise and watch the dashboards. Will follow up with a postmortem draft.
Samir Patel: Thanks all — assigning owners:
- Kate Morris (Auth): postmortem section: auth/session cascade and short-term fix
- Maria Gomez (Routing): routing-policy fallback behavior and cache tuning
- Alex Chen (SRE): DB RCA and long-running tx mitigation
- Julian Park (Support): customer comms + billing follow-up
Samir Patel: ETA for postmortem draft: EOD 2026-04-12. Closing thread once PMs confirm.
